notes.title: Enjoy Alpha Runner?
notes.notes:
Check out our artist new game on greenlight Magma Chamber!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/TGPhrwF.png[/img]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=646607103

Magma chamber is a puzzle based action game about a slime escaping a labyrinth of a lab inside of a volcano.

Each level has three objectives: Clear each tile, collect the children of slime, and get to the exit.
One wrong move and you could end your chances of clearing each tile or even worse- death.

Each zone has a unique boss fight that will require solving puzzles to defeat them. 

Dont forget to vote! Thank you. ːalienguyː

notes.title: PATCH 13 - Unique character abilities!
notes.notes:
[b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/serieus1] Serieus [/url] [/b]came with an awesome suggestion for the game, which was giving the character skins special abilities, i've tried playing around with it and found out that it's pretty fun and think you guys should check it out aswell!

Currently the abillities that are available are:
Space jump (Higher jump + floating effect)
Double jump 
Gotta go fast (run faster)
Magnet (Attract the score)

Let me know what you guys think!, and dont forget to suggest stuff in the discussion page, we read all of it!

Other fixes:
Sound/mute button fixed.
fps drop fixed.
Platform dissapear timer tweaked.


- LeGGo

notes.title: Patch 11. Controller support!
notes.notes:
Controller support is finally live for those who prefer the gamepad over the keyboard.

Keys:
Movement: Arrow pad.
Jump: X or A 
Action 1: LB
Action 2: RB
Action 3: LT

Keys might be buggy, so reporting your problem in the bugsection would help me improve the controlls.

Other updates:
Minor bugfixes to speedrun mode.


Dont forget to suggest idea's for the game! as it is nearing the end of EA.


- LeGGo

notes.title: Patch 10 Reworked SpeedRun
notes.notes:
I've reworked the speedrun gamemode to make it feel more like a speedrun, the world is now pre generated making you see all platforms in advance.

I've also made the world stay the same after death, (you can generate a new world by pressing R or getting to the finish).


Other news:
I will be looking into adding controller support and reworking MLG mode for the next patch.

Thanks.

- LeGGo

notes.title: Patch 9 - Lots of tweaks and Leaderboard reset!
notes.notes:
Info:

- Isaac worked on some new art for the alien minigame.
- Due to high demand i've removed the rain mini game and is now just a random visual.
- Sound effects added Space minigame.
- Sound effects added Dance minigame teleport.
- Generation bug fixed. (Obstacles shouldnt spawn at same position now.)
- Mini game fix, entering minigame pauses world outside it. so you dont randomly get killed when going back.
- Disabled mini-games for Speed run mode.
- Highscore,counters,levels and leaderboard reset!
- Some steam emoticons reworked, special thanks to Jur1z for making them.


Thanks for the support, and have fun!
- LeGGo

notes.title: PATCH 7: Prepare for Launch!
notes.notes:
Uploaded the Beta version of the second Mini Game, Alien Attack!
The Goal of the mini-game is to Beat the Alien boss ship by shooting it down with ur lasers!


[img] http://puu.sh/jgCUg/d8fa296e59.gif [/img]

Controlls:
Action button 1: Shoot laser.
Action button 2: Ends MiniGame.
Movement buttons to controll your ship.

This minigame is still being worked on, so you may find some bugs, when you do please let us know in the bug section of the discussion page so we can fix them right away.

I've also increased the spawnrate of the minigame for now, and you are able to spawn it in practice mode by pressing the F button.

Other news this patch:
Tweaked spawnrates.
Fixed memory leak bug.
Fixed minor bugs.
Also cards will be live soon!

Thanks! Alien out.[img] http://puu.sh/jgDvX/0f51233b06.png [/img]
